Real Club Deportivo Mallorca, S.A.D., commonly known as Real Mallorca or RCD Mallorca, is a Spanish professional football club based in Palma on the island of Mallorca in the Balearic Islands. Founded on 5 March 1916, they currently compete in Segunda División, holding home games at the Estadi Mallorca Son Moix with a 25,736-seat capacity.
